name: Novotel Jakarta Pulo Mas
short_description: A 175-room hotel in Pulo Mas, East Jakarta, opened December 2025, with a 28th-floor Food Exchange restaurant and an infinity pool.
ai_summary: Novotel Jakarta Pulo Mas is a newly opened 175-room hotel in Pulo Mas, East Jakarta, which held its grand opening in December 2025. Rooms span six categories, all fitted with the brand's Live N' Dream beds, smart TVs, and work desks, while upper-floor facilities include the Food Exchange restaurant, Lobby Lounge, and Gourmet Bar on the 27th-28th floors, plus an infinity pool, spa, and steam room. The hotel emphasizes an eco-smart design with solar power and water recycling, and early guest feedback highlights spacious, modern rooms and strong breakfast options, while a handful of early reviews mention inconsistent housekeeping and slow responses to special requests -- typical growing pains for a hotel only months into operation.

faqs.question: When did Novotel Jakarta Pulo Mas open?
faqs.answer: The hotel held its grand opening in December 2025 in the Pulo Mas area of East Jakarta. It offers 175 rooms across six categories, along with a 28th-floor Food Exchange restaurant, an infinity pool, spa, and large meeting facilities including a 720-guest ballroom, aimed at both business and leisure travellers.

faqs.question: What is the neighborhood like around Novotel Jakarta Pulo Mas?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits in Pulo Mas, East Jakarta, near shopping malls, government offices, hospitals, and sports facilities, with reasonable access to Halim Perdanakusuma International Airport. It's a more residential, business-oriented pocket of the city rather than Jakarta's central tourist districts like Thamrin or Sudirman.
